title: Warm Syrian Ground Beef Flatbread
description: A fermented, crunchy, and comforting Syrian dish featuring ground beef, perfect for a flexitarian-friendly meal, cooked on a comal.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, yeast, and salt.
Gradually add the water to the dry ingredients and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rest in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat the comal over medium heat.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Cook the flatbread on the comal for 1-2 minutes on each side, until it is lightly browned and crispy.
In a separate pan, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks, until it is no longer pink.
Add the chopped onion and sumac to the cooked ground beef and stir to combine.
Assemble the flatbread by spreading a quarter of the ground beef mixture onto each flatbread, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
